sentences.en: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己好像从噩梦中醒来。

sentences.en: This memory weighs, as a nightmare would, on my soul.
sentences.zh: 这段记忆压在我的心头，就像噩梦一样。

sentences.en: For someone like me, getting busted was the worst nightmare.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，被抓个正着是我最可怕的噩梦。
